config.experiment: M2 Gate 1 — redistribution-mismatch generality gate: sign / amplitude / spatial-shape controls of Delta = G - T on the canonical M1 dynamics
config.research_question: Stage 3 / M2 Gate 1: how do mismatch sign, mismatch amplitude, and mismatch spatial shape affect rebound, repeated rebound, switching, long-span churn-like transient, and exact stopping / finite-horizon censoring on the canonical M1 dynamics? (Frozen scope: no continuum, no Monte Carlo, no finite particles, no 2D, no perception, no alpha sweep, no deadband, no new stopping rules.)

frozen_inheritance.selection: cumulative-excess argmax D(j) = F(j) - j/K, ties -> smallest index (canonical, untouched)
frozen_inheritance.removal: prefix removal, each swept bin scaled by (1 - alpha) (canonical, untouched)
frozen_inheritance.exact_stopping: stop when D_max <= 1e-12 (canonical exact tolerance, untouched; tau_num below is NOT a stopping tolerance)
frozen_inheritance.initial_state: canonical q_near bin probabilities, identical for every kernel at a given K (shared; never regenerated per kernel)

K0.role: zero-mismatch / target-matched integrity reference (reuse of M1C.1 Variant U)

K-.role: negative mismatch mirror; sign control + theorem-backed implementation audit (G <= T order theorem applies)
K-.Delta: Delta_minus(x) = x^2 - x = -x(1-x) <= 0 (sign mirror of canonical Delta_C)

KW.role: weak positive mismatch amplitude ablation (lambda = 1/4 frozen; no family sweep)
KW.Delta: Delta_W(x) = (1/4) x(1-x) (same shape/sign as canonical at 1/4 amplitude)

KC.role: canonical q_near calibration anchor; minimal integrity reproduction only (no re-mining of canonical dynamics)

KS.role: positive spatial-shape control (flat-top vs parabolic hump; scope boundary: KS also changes mismatch regularity, so any KC-vs-KS difference may only be stated as sensitivity to mismatch spatial profile / regularity)
KS.Delta: Delta_S(x): 3/4 x on [0,1/3]; 1/4 on [1/3,2/3]; 3/4(1-x) on [2/3,1]; Delta_S >= 0, max = 1/4, integral = 1/6 (matched to canonical peak/integral/symmetry/endpoints)

config.discretization_rule: q_j = G(j/K) - G((j-1)/K) by exact evaluation of the analytic CDF on bin edges (ThrowDistribution.bin_probs); no midpoint density sampling, no approximate integration, no arbitrary normalization (only the canonical floating-point residue correction), no rounding of the KS breakpoints 1/3, 2/3 to the grid
config.tau_num_usage: Gate 1 floating validation tolerance only: mass normalization, decomposition residual acceptance, CDF checks, numerical-boundary classification; NOT a stopping tolerance (exact stopping semantics untouched)
config.horizon_rule: H(K) = 10*K active rounds, or exact stop, whichever happens first; if not stopped by 10K the observation is recorded as 'not stopped within pre-registered Gate-1 horizon' (finite-horizon censored). No automatic extension, no non-convergence interpretation.

switch_convention.definition: large boundary switch: |Delta a| > threshold (M1A.1 / M1C.4 diagnostic convention)

classification_convention.mapping: N_R = 0 -> No rebound; N_R = 1 -> Isolated rebound; N_R >= 2 and S_R/K < 1 -> Short recurrent transient; N_R >= 2 and S_R/K >= 1 -> Long-span recurrent / churn-like transient. S_R/K >= 1 is a REPORTING CONVENTION (like the M1C.4 switch threshold 0.2), not a claimed sharp transition; every label is reported together with its full quantitative signature (N_R, f_R, S_R/K, boundary switching, D_max behavior).
classification_convention.no_frozen_churn_threshold: there is no frozen N_R threshold that turns a count into 'churn'

config.R_t_definition: R_t = max over j with gamma_t(j) > 0 of [ M_t * max(Delta(j), 0) / gamma_t(j) ], gamma_t(j) = D_max(t) - D_TM_new,t(j) — exactly the M1C.4 definition; Delta from the kernel's own respray bins. R_t > 1 iff rebound is equivalent to the M1C.3 exact criterion in real arithmetic (verified per round).

theory_verification.decomposition_identity: D_new(j) = D_TM_new(j) + M * Delta(j) verified on every active round against the actual next state; max_abs_decomposition_residual recorded (acceptance <= tau_num)
theory_verification.rebound_criterion: actual rebound iff exists j: M*Delta(j) > gamma(j); TP/TN/FP/FN counted with plain strict semantics; rounds with |worst excess| <= tau_num flagged as numerical-boundary cases (not forced either way); unexplained non-boundary FP/FN pauses interpretation

K-: M1C.3 order theorem (G <= T) => every active round strictly decreases D_max; zero genuine rebounds; stopping time NOT known a priori (horizon censoring possible)
KW: G_W >= T somewhere => outside the G <= T stable class; rebound possible by the exact criterion; dynamics UNKNOWN (this is the experiment)
KC: canonical reproduction only (t_stop 324/699/1445/2876 at K=50/100/200/400)
KS: G_S >= T on (0,1) => outside the G <= T stable class; rebound possible; dynamics UNKNOWN; shape/regularity sensitivity is the question
